designRationale: The coastal-resort archetype uses ocean blue tones with sand and terracotta accents. The bg-gradient-to-t from-brand-primary/70 to-transparent creates a beach-to-sky gradient effect. Text-text-primary provides readability on the lighter coastal background. The min-h-hero-lg height emphasizes spaciousness and horizontal airy layout. The before:gradient overlay mimics ocean depth with the gradient-to-t pattern.
